messages:
lina: Heads-up: when switching the heatmap density toggle from 'High' -> 'Low' the p95 summary pill slides ~40px to the left for a frame and then snaps back. Happens with 3h+ ranges and Sampling=On. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/pill-snap.png

marc: I saw that too. Feels like the bucket width recalculation runs after the pill's absolute positioning is computed. Could be CSS layout thrash.

rachel: UX question: should the p95 pill be anchored to the scrubber thumb or to the chart container? Anchoring to the thumb gives clear context for the selected point, but anchoring to container avoids layout shifts when density changes.

tom: Technical: if we anchor to the thumb we can keep it in a fixed overlay layer (transform: translate3d) and update transform only on pointer events. That avoids reflow when bucket widths change.

lina: Accessibility: when the pill moves we lose keyboard focus on it. Keyboard users can't follow the value. Need to preserve focus ring and announce the new p95 value. a11y-bot: Recommend adding aria-live="polite" updates and tabindex=0 on the pill.

marc: Proposed quick solution: 1) render pill in an overlay layer tied to scrubber position via CSS transforms, 2) on density toggle keep overlay mounted and animate transform, 3) throttle layout recalculation so it doesn't fire mid-drag.

rachel: Microcopy: current toggle label 'Density' is ambiguous. Suggest 'Bucket resolution' with tooltip: 'Lower resolution groups buckets to reduce render cost; may slightly blur percentiles.'

a11y-bot: Microcopy note: avoid words like 'blur' for screen readers. Prefer 'approximate' and include a clarification that exact numbers are available when resolution is set to Highest.

tom: I'll try the overlay transform approach in a small PR. Also add aria-live node for p95 updates and ensure pill keeps focus when value changes.

lina: Another small UX nit: the time-range presets dropdown closes on ESC but doesn't return focus to the opener button. Keyboard flow break.

marc: Good catch. We'll ensure Escape focuses the opener per WAI-ARIA best practices.

tom: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/9824 — overlay + aria-live + focus fixes. Dev preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2166004321

rachel: Tested on staging: overlay prevents the snap; pill stays visually stable; VoiceOver reads p95 updates when scrubbing. One remaining edge: when density toggles during an active scrub the transform animation can stutter. Could be due to a 120ms layout debounce.

a11y-bot: Suggest lowering debounce to 40ms for active scrubbing and restoring 120ms when idle. Also add live-region prefix 'Chart percentiles:' so SR users get context.

lina: Agree. Let's ship the patch as a minor UX fix. Changelog line: 'Heatmap: stabilize p95 pill during density changes; improve keyboard focus & screen reader announcements.'

rachel: I'll add copy changes for the toggle to the copy PR and file an a11y follow-up for the stutter case. Thanks! :pray:
